summary: Min-plus powers generally have linear drift. Eventual periodicity of the unshifted sequence requires normalization and additional hypotheses; it does not hold for every min-plus matrix.
mechanism: 受限周期性结论被扩展到含非零漂移的系统

original.excerpt: min-plus matrix powers are eventually periodic
original.context: A registered external-theorem assumption summarizes a min-plus matrix theorem as unqualified eventual periodicity. It is an auxiliary asymptotic assertion, not the finite-round transfer identity.
original.locator: Archived external-theorem assumption registered 23 August 2026, assumption statement, lines 21–23.

witness.explanation: Min-plus powers generally have linear drift. Eventual periodicity of the unshifted sequence requires normalization and additional hypotheses; it does not hold for every min-plus matrix.
witness.evidence: For the one-by-one min-plus matrix A=[1], min-plus multiplication adds its only entry. By induction A^{⊙R}=[R] for every positive integer R. For any period p>0, A^{⊙(R+p)}=[R+p]≠[R]=A^{⊙R}, at every R. This exactly refutes the unqualified statement. It does not refute the finite-round transfer formula or the more careful zero-cycle normalized argument for the specific transfer matrices.
